242:                     hash := keccak256(t, 0x40) // Compute the `PersonalSign` struct hash.
243:                     break

250:                 mstore(add(p, c), 40) // Store a '(' after the end.

252:                     let e := 0 // Length of `contentsName` in explicit mode.

259:                     mstore8(add(p, e), 40) // Store a '(' exactly right after the end.
260:                 }

262:                 let d := shr(byte(0, mload(p)), 0x7fffffe000000000000010000000000) // Starts with `[a-z(]`.
263:                 // Advance `p` until we encounter '('.
264:                 for {} iszero(eq(byte(0, mload(p)), 40)) { p := add(p, 1) } {
265:                     d := or(shr(byte(0, mload(p)), 0x120100000001), d) // Has a byte in ", )\x00".
266:                 }
267:                 mstore(p, " contents,string name,string") // Store the rest of the encoding.
268:                 mstore(add(p, 0x1c), " version,uint256 chainId,address")
269:                 mstore(add(p, 0x3c), " verifyingContract,bytes32 salt)")
270:                 p := add(p, 0x5c)
271:                 calldatacopy(p, add(o, 0x40), c) // Copy `contentsType`.
272:                 // Fill in the missing fields of the `TypedDataSign`.
273:                 calldatacopy(t, o, 0x40) // Copy the `contents` struct hash to `add(t, 0x20)`.
274:                 mstore(t, keccak256(m, sub(add(p, c), m))) // Store `typedDataSignTypehash`.

279:                 hash := keccak256(0x1e, add(0x42, and(1, d)))

281:                 break

284:         }

library SignatureCheckerLib {
    /*´:°•.°+.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°•.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°+.*•´.*:*/

    /*.•°:°.´+˚.*°.˚:*.´•*.+°.•°:´*.´•*.•°.•°:°.´:•˚°.*°.˚:*.´+°.•*/

        0x6492649264926492649264926492649264926492649264926492649264926492;

    /*´:°•.°+.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°•.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°+.*•´.*:*/
    /*                 SIGNATURE CHECKER FUNCTIONS                */
    /*.•°:°.´+˚.*°.˚:*.´•*.+°.•°:´*.´•*.•°.•°:°.´:•˚°.*°.˚:*.´+°.•*/

    /// @notice Validates if a given signature is valid for a specific signer and hash.
    function isValidSignatureNow(address signer, bytes32 hash, bytes memory signature)
        internal
        view
        returns (bool isValid)
    {
        /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
        assembly {
            let m := mload(0x40) // Cache the free memory pointer.
            for {} 1 {} {
                if iszero(signer) { break }
                // Direct ECDSA validation.
                let t := mload(signature)
                switch t
                case 64 {
                    let vs := mload(add(signature, 0x40))
                    mstore(0x20, add(shr(255, vs), 27)) // `v`.
                    mstore(0x60, shr(1, shl(1, vs))) // `s`.
                }
                case 65 {
                    mstore(0x20, byte(0, mload(add(signature, 0x60)))) // `v`.
                    mstore(0x60, mload(add(signature, 0x40))) // `s`.
                }
                default {

                    isValid := _isValidERC1271SignatureNow(signer, hash, add(signature, 0x20), t)

                mstore(0x00, hash)
                mstore(0x40, mload(add(signature, 0x20))) // `r`.
                let v := mload(staticcall(gas(), 1, 0x00, 0x80, 0x01, 0x20))
                mstore(0x60, 0) // Restore the zero slot.

125:     /// while still enabling wallet UIs (e.g. Metamask) to show the EIP-712 values.
126:     ///
127:     /// Crafted for phishing resistance, efficiency, flexibility.
128:     /// __________________________________________________________________________________________
129:     ///
130:     /// Glossary:
131:     ///
132:     /// - `APP_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR`: The domain separator of the `hash` passed in by the application.
133:     ///   Provided by the front end. Intended to be the domain separator of the contract
134:     ///   that will call `isValidSignature` on this account.
135:     ///
136:     /// - `ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR`: The domain separator of this account.
137:     ///   See: `EIP712._domainSeparator()`.
138:     /// __________________________________________________________________________________________
139:     ///
140:     /// For the `TypedDataSign` workflow, the final hash will be:
141:     /// ```
142:     ///     keccak256(\x19\x01 ‖ APP_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR ‖
143:     ///         hashStruct(TypedDataSign({
144:     ///             contents: hashStruct(originalStruct),
145:     ///             name: keccak256(bytes(eip712Domain().name)),
146:     ///             version: keccak256(bytes(eip712Domain().version)),
147:     ///             chainId: eip712Domain().chainId,
148:     ///             verifyingContract: eip712Domain().verifyingContract,
149:     ///             salt: eip712Domain().salt

151:     ///     )
152:     /// ```
153:     /// where `‖` denotes the concatenation operator for bytes.
154:     /// The order of the fields is important: `contents` comes before `name`.
155:     ///
156:     /// The signature will be `r ‖ s ‖ v ‖ APP_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR ‖
157:     ///     contents ‖ contentsDescription ‖ uint16(contentsDescription.length)`,
158:     /// where:
159:     /// - `contents` is the bytes32 struct hash of the original struct.
160:     /// - `contentsDescription` can be either:
161:     ///     a) `contentsType` (implicit mode)
162:     ///         where `contentsType` starts with `contentsName`.
163:     ///     b) `contentsType ‖ contentsName` (explicit mode)
164:     ///         where `contentsType` may not necessarily start with `contentsName`.

167:     /// __________________________________________________________________________________________
168:     ///
169:     /// For the `PersonalSign` workflow, the final hash will be:
170:     /// ```
171:     ///     keccak256(\x19\x01 ‖ ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR ‖
172:     ///         hashStruct(PersonalSign({
173:     ///             prefixed: keccak256(bytes(\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n ‖
174:     ///                 base10(bytes(someString).length) ‖ someString))
175:     ///         }))
176:     ///     )
177:     /// ```
178:     /// where `‖` denotes the concatenation operator for bytes.
179:     ///
180:     /// The `PersonalSign` type hash will be `keccak256("PersonalSign(bytes prefixed)")`.
181:     /// The signature will be `r ‖ s ‖ v`.
182:     /// __________________________________________________________________________________________
183:     ///
184:     /// For demo and typescript code, see:
185:     /// - https://github.com/junomonster/nested-eip-712
186:     /// - https://github.com/frangio/eip712-wrapper-for-eip1271

189:     ///

198:         view
199:         virtual
200:         returns (bool result)
201:     {

206:                 ,
207:                 string memory name,
208:                 string memory version,
209:                 uint256 chainId,
210:                 address verifyingContract,
211:                 bytes32 salt,
212:             ) = eip712Domain();

214:             assembly {
215:                 t := mload(0x40) // Grab the free memory pointer.
216:                 // Skip 2 words for the `typedDataSignTypehash` and `contents` struct hash.
217:                 mstore(add(t, 0x40), keccak256(add(name, 0x20), mload(name)))
218:                 mstore(add(t, 0x60), keccak256(add(version, 0x20), mload(version)))
219:                 mstore(add(t, 0x80), chainId)
220:                 mstore(add(t, 0xa0), shr(96, shl(96, verifyingContract)))
221:                 mstore(add(t, 0xc0), salt)
222:                 mstore(0x40, add(t, 0xe0)) // Allocate the memory.
223:             }
224:         }

226:         assembly {
227:             let m := mload(0x40) // Cache the free memory pointer.
228:             // `c` is `contentsDescription.length`, which is stored in the last 2 bytes of the signature.
229:             let c := shr(240, calldataload(add(signature.offset, sub(signature.length, 2))))

231:                 let l := add(0x42, c) // Total length of appended data (32 + 32 + c + 2).
232:                 let o := add(signature.offset, sub(signature.length, l)) // Offset of appended data.
233:                 mstore(0x00, 0x1901) // Store the "\x19\x01" prefix.

240:                     mstore(t, _PERSONAL_SIGN_TYPEHASH)

242:                     hash := keccak256(t, 0x40) // Compute the `PersonalSign` struct hash.
243:                     break
244:                 }
245:                 // Else, use the `TypedDataSign` workflow.

250:                 mstore(add(p, c), 40) // Store a '(' after the end.
251:                 if iszero(eq(byte(0, mload(sub(add(p, c), 1))), 41)) {

253:                     for { let q := sub(add(p, c), 1) } 1 {} {

255:                         if iszero(gt(lt(e, c), eq(byte(0, mload(sub(q, e))), 41))) { break }

257:                     c := sub(c, e) // Truncate `contentsDescription` to `contentsType`.
258:                     calldatacopy(p, add(add(o, 0x40), c), e) // Copy `contentsName`.
259:                     mstore8(add(p, e), 40) // Store a '(' exactly right after the end.
260:                 }
261:                 // `d & 1 == 1` means that `contentsName` is invalid.
262:                 let d := shr(byte(0, mload(p)), 0x7fffffe000000000000010000000000) // Starts with `[a-z(]`.
263:                 // Advance `p` until we encounter '('.
264:                 for {} iszero(eq(byte(0, mload(p)), 40)) { p := add(p, 1) } {
265:                     d := or(shr(byte(0, mload(p)), 0x120100000001), d) // Has a byte in ", )\x00".
266:                 }
267:                 mstore(p, " contents,string name,string") // Store the rest of the encoding.
268:                 mstore(add(p, 0x1c), " version,uint256 chainId,address")
269:                 mstore(add(p, 0x3c), " verifyingContract,bytes32 salt)")
270:                 p := add(p, 0x5c)
271:                 calldatacopy(p, add(o, 0x40), c) // Copy `contentsType`.
272:                 // Fill in the missing fields of the `TypedDataSign`.
273:                 calldatacopy(t, o, 0x40) // Copy the `contents` struct hash to `add(t, 0x20)`.
274:                 mstore(t, keccak256(m, sub(add(p, c), m))) // Store `typedDataSignTypehash`.
275:                 // The "\x19\x01" prefix is already at 0x00.
276:                 // `APP_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR` is already at 0x20.
277:                 mstore(0x40, keccak256(t, 0xe0)) // `hashStruct(typedDataSign)`.
278:                 // Compute the final hash, corrupted if `contentsName` is invalid.
279:                 hash := keccak256(0x1e, add(0x42, and(1, d)))
280:                 signature.length := sub(signature.length, l) // Truncate the signature.
281:                 break
282:             }
283:             mstore(0x40, m) // Restore the free memory pointer.
284:         }
285:         if (t == uint256(0)) hash = _hashTypedData(hash); // `PersonalSign` workflow.
286:         result = _erc1271IsValidSignatureNowCalldata(hash, signature);
287:     }

305:                 let b := 0x000000000000378eDCD5B5B0A24f5342d8C10485 // Basefee contract,
306:                 pop(staticcall(0xffff, b, codesize(), gasprice(), gasprice(), 0x20))

314:                     // Burns gas computationally efficiently. Also, requires that `gas > gasToBurn`.
315:                     if or(eq(hash, b), lt(gas(), gasToBurn)) { invalid() }

317:                     // No valid transaction can consume more than the gaslimit.
318:                     // See: https://ethereum.github.io/yellowpaper/paper.pdf
319:                     // Most RPCs perform calls with a gas budget greater than the gaslimit.
320:                     pop(staticcall(gasToBurn, address(), 0x1c, 0x64, gasprice(), gasprice()))

322:                 }
